Apartment overview

Before I go any further I wish to inform you that I now own the apartment next door which is essentially an identical property offering similar facilities. This apartment is available, in addition to the current one, for the months of April, May, June, July, August, September and October. This makes it ideal for two family groups or groups of friends and it sleeps up to four people. This property can be viewed under property number 366973.

Now back to the current property. Luxury modern ground floor spacious two bedroom, two bathroom apartment on a secure gated complex in Marbella, Costa del Sol, Spain. The apartment has a ground floor entrance from the road, but has an elevated position from the terrace, which overlooks the main pool and the gardens and has views of the sea. There is direct access to the gardens from the garage underneath the apartment. The apartment is situated near the sea, between the golf courses of Cabopino and Santa Maria on the attractive development of La Reserva de Marbella(Phase 1). It is not part of the large Phase II development further in land. This area of the Spain is also known as the Costa del Golf, as there are some fifty courses on the Costa del Sol.

The apartment, which can accommodate up to four people is fully furnished with good quality furniture and fittings in traditional Spanish style with marble floors throughout. The bedrooms can be configured for two super king size or four single beds or a combination of the two. Also can be provided are beach towels. A BBQ is provided for al fresco dining.

It has remote controlled air conditioning in the living and bedrooms, providing cooling, heating and de-humidifying and each room can be controlled separately. It also has large walk in showers in both bathrooms There is a remote controlled awning to shade the terrace if required and it also has a dedicated car parking space in the garage below the apartment block.

The development is located just to the east of Marbella town and close to one of the best beaches on the coast and the lovely marina at Cabopino. There are many restaurants, beaches, bars, golf clubs, shops and amusements in the area and the famous resort and marina of Puerto Banus is within easy reach. Things to do and see in the local area include Water Sports, Water Parks, Wild Life Park, Sea Life Centre, Adventure Park, Theme Park, Butterfly Park, Crocodile Park, Zoo, Paragliding, Trampolines and Cinemas plus of course the Sea, the Beaches, beach Bars and even Shopping if you want to do that on holiday. Malaga airport is around thirty five minutes away by car and car hire is advised to get the very best from the holiday.

This part of Spain is active all year round and has a superb climate, averaging 300 days of sunshine per year, with daytime temperatures in winter often reaching over 20C. The Costa del Sol is the most popular holiday destination in Spain, with it's golden-sand beaches, stunning coastline and such popular and world-renowned places like Marbella, Puerto Banus, Gibratar, Fueringola, Benalmadena, There are plenty of places to explore inland including Mijas Pueblo and Ronda and the white villages of Ojen and Monda etc. The cities of Malaga, Granada, Sevilla, Cadiz and Cordoba are not far away. You can even catch a ferry to Morocco. You will have plenty to do and see

A car is by far the best way to get around the area, to go to the beach, sightseeing and shopping. There is however a good bus service along the main coast round which is a five minute walk away. This service goes to Marbella, Fuengirola and beyond. There are also local taxi services available. The nearest railway station is at Fuengirola with trains to Malaga and the airport. This service does not go any further west than Fuengirola.
